sources.title: 2016 governance report: Ruffini biography
sources.findings: Born Como August 27, 1961; training Italy/US, worked with father Gianfranco; founded New England in 1984 and acquired Moncler in 2003.
sources.caution: Read biography only. No named degree verified; historical 32% holding not current. Official 1984 used over secondary 1983. Old PDF links redirected or failed; migrated asset read.

sources.title: 2022 annual report: brand history
sources.findings: Moncler founded 1952 by René Ramillon and André Vincent; Ruffini acquisition 2003; Milan listing December 16, 2013; Genius 2018; Stone Island acquisition completed March 31, 2021.
sources.caution: Read history page only. Ruffini is acquirer, not 1952 founder. Historical CEO title superseded. Stone Island December 2020 agreement distinct from 2021 completion.

sources.title: 2026 half-year report: management transition
sources.findings: Rongone joined as CEO April 1, 2026; Ruffini executive chairman retains creative-direction oversight. April 21 AGM confirmed Rongone director.
sources.caution: Read significant-event section, not all 73 pages. January announcement is not effective transition date. Ruffini remains executive, not retired or nonexecutive.

sources.title: Current board of directors
sources.findings: Lists Remo Ruffini executive chairman and Bartolomeo Rongone CEO.
sources.caution: Current roster corroborates completed transition; older biographies/interviews still use combined CEO title.

sources.title: 2025 governance report: Double R shareholder agreements
sources.findings: September 26, 2024 LVMH vehicle White acquired 10% of Double R from Ruffini holding; transaction closed same date.
sources.caution: Read agreement section only. Stake is in Double R, not direct 10% Moncler. Original investment agreement provisions ended September 11, 2025 after subsequent transactions; do not assert initial percentages still current.

sources.title: 26 September 2024: LVMH partnership
sources.findings: Corroborates LVMH investment in Ruffini-controlled Double R.
sources.caution: Historical report, not current cap table or LVMH acquisition of all Moncler. RTÉ mirror 403 and Yahoo mirror 429; Reuters original opening read.

sources.title: 1 October 2026: Ruffini interview
sources.findings: Interview discusses New York store and retail strategy.
sources.caution: Publication date, not established interview date. Article’s CEO description is stale against current board and half-year report; retained only as recent interview evidence. No store financial-return claim.
